function.name: COLLISION
function.param: Identifier of a process, or of a type of process by the instruction , or the number 0 or the special instruction TYPE MOUSE
function.abstract: Find collisions of any type against the current process

description.p: This is the main function of collision, that finds a process that, according to his graph, position on screen according to its variables and and values of flags, it will collide with the current in case of being both drawn immediately. In case of finding a process, this function returns his (that always is a uneven number). In opposite case, it will return 0.

According to the value specified like parameter, it is possible:
Find any process which makes collision (using 0 like parameter)
Find any process of a determined type which makes collision (for it, we use like parameter the expression PROCESS, where PROCESS is the name of some kind of process
Check if a determined process makes collision with the current (using like parameter his value of , or by the operator, or for being stored in a variable like .
Check if the mouse is on the current process, using the special expression TYPE MOUSE.

The verification is perfect to level of pixel, and it considers differences of size, rotations, and works althought the objects are not in visible limits of the screen or althought only the part which collides will be out of screen. That has important consequences: for example, an object which is a donut will not collide with an smaller object that is drawn whitin it, if this other object does not touch a non-transparent pixel.
However, both process must be visible so that this function checks the existence of a collision. Consult this function for more information.

The successive calls to the function COLLISION with the same parameters return the following processes of the specified type which make collision, until there are not any, in which case this function returns 0. This method allows, by a curl, find all process which make collision with the current.

function.note: The operation of COLLISION(TYPE MOUSE) is special, because it does not check the collision with the full graph of mouse (MOUSE.GRAPH), but only with the center indicated by MOUSE.X and MOUSE.Y, then the function returns 1.
